Benefits include 401k, PTO, and tuition reimbursement, along with a supportive team environment that emphasizes high-quality patient care.

jobs.title: Flexible Security Officer — Patrol, Respond, Protect
jobs.description: A security services provider located in Dallas, TX is seeking a Security Officer - Flex responsible for maintaining safety and security for employees and visitors. Key duties include patrolling premises, monitoring access, responding to alarms, and communicating with law enforcement. Candidates must possess a high school diploma, active security license, and a valid Texas driver's license. Excellent communication skills and the ability to handle emergencies calmly are required. This role offers a dynamic work environment and the opportunity to be part of a dedicated team.

jobs.title: Security Guard: Access Control & Patrol Specialist
jobs.description:
Admiral Security Services is looking for security personnel in DeSoto, Texas. Responsibilities include access control, enforcing policies, and reporting hazards. Candidates must have steel toe boots, reliable transportation, and be at least 21 years old. Exceptional customer service and multitasking abilities are essential.

This role involves working in various weather conditions and standing for long periods. Ideal for those with experience in security, military, or related fields.
